message.unknown: This message can't be displayed ({id}): the frontend and kiln-server versions may differ. Refresh the page and try again.
message.invalid: This message is malformed and can't be displayed. Refresh the page and try again.
app.unknownPageDetail: The frontend doesn't recognize the page {page}: the frontend and kiln-server versions may differ. Refresh the page and try again.
page.dataInvalidDetail: The frontend and kiln-server versions may differ. Refresh the page and try again. ({page}: {where})
router.tooManyRedirects: The page redirected too many times. Refresh the page and try again.
router.submitFailed: Submission failed. Refresh the page and try again.
api.network: Can't reach the Kiln Server. Check your network, then refresh the page.
api.status: The server returned {status}. Try again later.
api.unparsable: The page data returned by the server can't be parsed. Refresh the page and try again.
api.malformed: The page data returned by the server is malformed. Refresh the page and try again.
shell.tokenNoticeBound: You're signed in with the admin token. <link>Sign in with GitHub instead</link>
shell.tokenNoticeUnbound: You're signed in with the admin token. <link>Link your GitHub account</link>, then sign in with GitHub.
shell.expired: Your session has expired and auto-refresh has stopped. <link>Sign in again</link>
locale.label: Language
login.title: Sign in to Kiln
login.tokenFallback: Administrator fallback: sign in with the admin token
login.tokenForm: Sign in with the admin token
login.tokenCaption: The KILN_ADMIN_TOKEN configured on the Server. It has full administrator rights. Don't save it on a shared computer.
login.noOAuth: This Server has no GitHub sign-in configured. Only an administrator can sign in, with the admin token.
login.unavailable: Admin token sign-in is turned off and this Server has no GitHub sign-in configured. An administrator can run kiln admin token-login on on the server to restore it.
login.hintBound: After signing in with the admin token you act as the linked GitHub account {login}. Use it only when GitHub sign-in is unavailable.
login.hintUnbound: The first time, sign in with the admin token, then link your GitHub account under Settings → Sign-in & identity.
login.hintTokenOff: Admin token sign-in is turned off. If GitHub sign-in becomes unavailable, an administrator can run kiln admin token-login on on the server to restore it.
login.hintConfigureOAuth: Once GitHub sign-in (KILN_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID) is configured, you and other members can sign in with GitHub accounts.
login.signedIn: You're signed in as {login} ({role}). You can continue, or sign in as someone else below.
login.noticeExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to return to the page you were on.
login.noticeRevoked: Your session is no longer valid: an administrator changed the sign-in methods or account permissions (for example, turned off admin token sign-in). Sign in again.
login.errTokenDisabled: Admin token sign-in is turned off. Sign in with GitHub.
login.errTokenInvalid: The admin token is incorrect; you weren't signed in. Check that you copied all of it (no spaces or line breaks).
error.serverHeading: Something went wrong on the server
error.serverReasonGet: An internal error occurred while handling this request. The details are in the server log. You can try again later; if the problem persists, give the error ID below to an administrator.
error.serverReasonPost: An internal error occurred while handling this action, so it may not have completed. The details are in the server log. Go back to the previous page and check the result before deciding whether to retry; if the problem persists, give the error ID below to an administrator.
error.notFoundReason: The address may be mistyped, or what you're looking for no longer exists.
error.forbiddenReason: Only administrators can use this page or action. You're signed in as {login}, a member, and nothing was done. Contact an administrator if needed, or sign in again as an administrator.
error.csrfHeading: The page has expired; nothing was done
error.csrfReason: The form's security check (CSRF) failed, usually because the page was open too long, you signed in again in the meantime, or the form came from another site. Go back to the previous page, refresh it, and try again.
error.oauthDisabledReason: This Server has no GitHub sign-in configured (KILN_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID). Administrators can sign in with the admin token on the sign-in page.
error.oauthInvalidReason: The parameters returned by GitHub sign-in are invalid or were modified (for example, an old or incomplete link was opened), so you weren't signed in. Go back to the sign-in page and sign in again.
error.oauthOtherBrowserReason: This GitHub authorization wasn't started in this browser (for example, you opened a link someone sent you, or opened the callback address in another browser), so you weren't signed in. Sign in with GitHub again from the sign-in page.

error.oauthExpiredReason.one: More than {count, number} minute passed between opening the GitHub authorization page and returning to Kiln, so it didn't complete. Please try again.
error.oauthExpiredReason.other: More than {count, number} minutes passed between opening the GitHub authorization page and returning to Kiln, so it didn't complete. Please try again.

error.oauthDeniedReason: GitHub didn't complete the authorization (for example, Cancel was clicked on the authorization page), so nothing was signed in or linked. You can try again.
error.oauthNoAccessHeading: This GitHub account doesn't have access
error.oauthNoAccessReason: The GitHub account {login} isn't the account linked by the administrator and isn't on Kiln's member or administrator lists (KILN_USERS / KILN_ADMINS), so you weren't signed in. Ask an administrator to add it; to use a different account, sign out of GitHub first and then sign in again.
error.oauthFailedReason: Kiln couldn't get your account information from GitHub (a network problem, GitHub being temporarily unavailable, or an authorization code that was already used), so sign-in didn't complete. You can retry; if the problem persists, give the error ID to an administrator.
error.bindInvalidReason: This GitHub authorization wasn't started by the administrator who is currently signed in (for example, the link was opened in another browser, or you signed in again in the meantime), so nothing was linked. Link the account again under Settings → Sign-in & identity.
account.bound: Linked GitHub account {login}. You're now signed in as {login}.
account.unbound: Unlinked. Admin token sign-in has been restored.
copy.label: Copy
